other_conditions: Must be registered under the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
Must have a minimum of three years of regular membership
Disability must be caused by an infectious disease or workplace accident during employment
Permanent disability percentage must be between 70% and 100%
Must not be receiving a disability pension from any other Haryana Government department, board or corporation
Must upload a No Objection Certificate issued by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
Must upload a declaration confirming non‑receipt of any other government disability pension
Must upload a life certificate and deposit the prescribed contribution each year in November
benefits_summary: A monthly pension of ₹3000 is provided to eligible disabled workers.
documents_required: No Objection Certificate issued by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
Declaration stating non‑receipt of pension from any other Government Department/Board/Corporation/institution
